field_name_hint: How other participants see you, e.g. “Anna M.”.
login_intro: With your email address. New here? Your account is created automatically.
login_welcome_intro: Please enter your e-mail address if you have an account or would like to create one:
guest_hint: We’ll send all the details about the event to your e-mail address. No password needed.
guest_error_email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
guest_sent_notice: We’ve sent all the details about the event to {email}.
guest_known_hint: There is already an account for this e-mail address. Log in with it to change your registration or to see the rides.
guest_taken: There already is a registration for this e-mail address.
guest_taken_login: Log in to change the registration
mail_confirm_guest_hint: You registered without a password. To change your registration later, open the event and log in with this e-mail address – you’ll get a login link.
login_error_email: Please enter a valid email address.
login_error_credentials: Wrong password. You can also have a login link sent to you.
login_error_rate: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
login_error_mail: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
login_sent_text: We sent a login link to {email}.
login_sent_hint: The link is valid for 15 minutes. Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder.
link_invalid_text: This login link has expired or has already been used.
mail_login_intro: Hi! Use the button below to log in to toodle.
mail_login_validity: The link is valid for 15 minutes and works only once.
mail_login_footer: Didn't request this? Then you can simply ignore this email.
error_contact: This doesn't look valid. Please give phone numbers with the country code, e.g. +352 621 123 456.
error_place: Please pick an address from the search results and enter a label.
error_password: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
error_confirm_email: The email address does not match.
profile_contacts_hint: You can add several, for example phone and Signal. Only participants of the same event can see them.
profile_places_hint: Places you often leave from or return to. Others only see the town or district.
profile_password_set: You have a password. Login links via email still work.
profile_password_none: You log in via email link. Optionally, you can set a password.
profile_delete_hint: Deletes your account including all places, contact options and registrations. This cannot be undone.
error_404_text: This page doesn't exist (anymore). Maybe the link is outdated.
error_generic_text: Please try again in a moment.
dashboard_empty: You're not organizing anything right now. Creating an event takes two minutes.
event_new_intro: First the basics, then the registration form – after that your event is online.
event_location_hint: Needed for the ride view and required to publish.
event_description_hint: Programme, costs, what to bring … Line breaks are kept.
event_contact_email_hint: Shown to participants. Replies to toodle notifications go to this address.
event_error_end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
event_error_location: Please pick the place from the search results.
event_error_deadline: The deadline must be before the end.
event_error_capacity: Please enter a whole number between 1 and 100,000.
event_error_contact_email: Please enter a valid email address.
event_visibility_public_hint: All registered participants see all rides.
event_visibility_matched_hint: Everyone only sees rides that fit their own: a small detour, a fitting time.
event_visibility_internal_hint: Only the organizing team sees the rides and matches people.
event_visibility_large: For more than {count} people we recommend “Matches only”, so not everyone sees everybody’s rides.
event_visibility_widen_confirm: People have already registered. Their rides will become visible to more people than stated when they signed up. Change anyway.
event_error_visibility_widen: Please confirm that the rides should become visible to more people.
event_copied_notice: Copy created. Now adjust the title and dates.
event_status_draft_hint: Only your team can see the event. Publish it so others can sign up via the link.
event_status_published_hint: The event is reachable via the link.
event_status_archived_hint: Archived – no longer public. You can restore it any time or duplicate it as a template.
event_blocker_location: The address is still missing for publishing.
event_blocker_contact: The contact email is still missing for publishing.
event_blocker_past: The event is in the past.
event_blocker_unverified: Please confirm your e-mail address {email} first. That way, there is always someone reachable behind an event.
event_verify_sent: The link is on its way to {email}. One click is all it takes – then you can publish.
event_verify_rate: Several links were sent just now. Please wait a few minutes.
event_verify_error: The mail could not be sent. Please try again later.
event_blocker_generic: The event can't be published like this yet.
event_duplicate_hint: Duplicating copies details and form – ideal for recurring events. Registrations and team are not copied.
event_delete_hint: Permanently deletes the event with its form and all registrations. Everyone registered gets a cancellation by e-mail.
builder_unsaved_confirm: The form has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
builder_error_options: Question {number} needs at least two answer options.
builder_error_travel_twice: There can only be one travel field.
builder_error_invalid: The form could not be saved.
team_hint: Everyone on the team can edit the event and sees all registrations.
team_error_last: The last person on the team can't be removed.
team_invite_hint: Send the link to someone who should co-organize. They log in and join the team.
team_invite_once: The link works once and is valid for 7 days.
invite_invalid_text: This invite link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
public_preview_banner: Preview – this event is not published yet.
dashboard_unfinished_hint: Looked at, but not registered yet.
car_status_label: Do you have room in your car?
car_status_hint: You can change this any time – even right before you leave.
car_note_placeholder: e.g. small detour ok, little boot space
flexible_hint: You can drive or ride along – whatever is needed. You show up both as a driver and among those looking for a ride.
travel_coordinate_question: Do you want to travel together?
travel_intro: So you can arrange rides. Other participants only see the town or district, never your address.
travel_visibility_public: All registered participants see your trip.
travel_visibility_matched: Only participants whose way fits yours see your trip.
travel_visibility_internal: Only the organizing team sees your trip. They match people for rides.
travel_error_required: Please choose how you travel there and back (“Not specified” is fine too).
travel_error_place: Please say where you leave from or where you're going.
travel_error_pickup: Say where you can be picked up, and choose each place from the search results.
registration_answers_locked: The deadline has passed – your answers are final, but you can still change travel details and your comment.
registration_withdraw_confirm: Do you really want to cancel? You can sign up again as long as registration is open.
registration_full: Sorry, the event is fully booked.
registration_draft_hint: The registration form appears here once the event is published.
registration_no_contact_hint: Add a contact option so others can reach you about rides.
rides_not_registered: Only registered participants can see the ride view.
rides_privacy: Only towns/districts and stations are shown – never addresses. You arrange rides directly with each other.
rides_matched_note: For this event you only see rides that fit yours.
rides_matched_no_leg: Add how you travel, then you’ll see matching rides here.
rides_no_matching_drivers: Right now nobody with a free seat is going your way.
rides_no_matching_seekers: Right now nobody on your route is looking for a ride.
rides_internal_note: For this event only the organizing team sees the rides and matches people. Once you’re matched, the person shows up here.
rides_orga_note_matched: As an organizer you see all rides. Participants only see rides that fit theirs.
rides_orga_note_internal: As an organizer you see all rides. Participants only see their own and whom you match them with.
rides_no_leg: You didn't enter anything for this direction.
rides_no_drivers: Nobody has entered a car trip yet.
rides_seekers_hint: Sorted by detour for you – worth checking again shortly before the trip.
rides_seekers_together: Maybe you can find a ride together.
rides_flexible_hint: You're flexible: ride with someone or take someone along yourself.
rides_no_seekers: Nobody is looking for a ride right now.
orga_rides_no_travel_field: The form has no travel field – add it in the “Form” tab.
participants_export_hint: For Excel, LibreOffice & co. – one row per person with all answers. Addresses are not included, only place/station.
participants_withdraw_hint: The registration is kept as “withdrawn” and can be restored. Ride links are removed.
participants_empty: No registrations yet. Share the link from the overview.
planning_days_hint: Estimated from travel details. Without a time, a person counts for the whole event.

mail_confirm_matches_seeker: People are already driving your way ({count}):
mail_confirm_matches_driver: People on your route are already looking for a ride ({count}):

mail_match_subject_driver: Someone on your route needs a ride – {title}
mail_match_intro_seeker: there is news on your way to “{title}”:
mail_match_intro_driver: people on your route to “{title}” are looking for a ride:
mail_match_hint: If it fits, just get in touch directly – contact options are in the ride view.
mail_rides_footer: toodle doesn't book anything – you arrange rides directly with each other.
mail_reply_orga: Questions? Just reply to this email – it goes to the organizers.
mail_reply_rides: Replies to this email go to the organizers. To arrange the ride itself, use the contact options in the ride view.
mail_link_hint: Something wrong? You can remove the link in the ride view.
mail_reminder_text: your travel to “{title}” is still open. If you add it, others can see whether you could travel together – and the organizers can plan better.
mail_reminder_drivers: So far {count} are going by car.
mail_reminder_footer: You only get this reminder once per event.
profile_notify_hint: By email or push. Every mail also contains an unsubscribe link.
profile_notify_rides_hint: When someone drives your way or looks for a ride on your route – at most every few hours, never twice about the same person.
profile_notify_reminders_hint: Once, if your travel is still open shortly before the event.
offline_banner: Offline – you are seeing the last loaded version. Changes need a connection again.
install_hint: Opens like an app and shows your registrations offline, too.
install_ios: In Safari: Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
mail_match_driver_line_way: {direction}: {name}{place} is driving – you are on the way
mail_match_seeker_line_way: {direction}: {name}{place} is looking for a ride – right on your way
push_hint: Ride hints and reminders straight to your phone – instead of by email. Registration confirmations still come by email.
push_unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
push_ios: On iPhone and iPad, push notifications only work when toodle is installed as an app (Share → “Add to Home Screen”). Then open toodle from there.
push_denied: Notifications for toodle are blocked in your browser settings. Allow them there to use push.
push_on: Push is enabled on this device.
push_off_hint: Push is off on this device.
push_error: That didn't work. Please try again later.
push_error_limit: Push is already enabled on too many devices. Remove one first.
push_reminder_body: Your travel is still open – add it so you can travel together.
profile_mail_with_push_hint: Hints and reminders by email as well, even with push enabled.
login_use_link: Email me a login link instead
login_forgot_hint: Also if you forgot your password.
login_sent_password_tip: Tip: set a password in your profile – then next time works without email.
range_pick_end: Pick the last day – or the same day again for one day
builder_travel_off_hint: Off – without travel details there are no rides.
builder_preview_title: This is what your guests will see:
builder_travel_benefit: Your guests say how they're getting there – and see who is driving from nearby. Carpools happen almost by themselves.
builder_help_placeholder: e.g. So we can plan enough food

builder_error_link: Question {number}: the link is not a valid web address.

builder_example_number: e.g. How many children are coming?
builder_example_single_choice: e.g. food: vegetarian, vegan or anything
builder_example_checkbox: e.g. May we show photos of you?
settings_registration_closed: Registration is closed – no new registrations, existing ones stay.
settings_registration_not_published: Once the event is published, you can close and reopen registration here.
overview_published_text: Now just share the link – everyone who registers sees right away who is driving from nearby.
overview_visibility_hint: Already {count} registrations, and everyone sees everybody’s rides. For events this big we recommend “Matches only”.
registration_contact_title: How can others reach you about rides?
onboarding_password_hint: If you set a password, you can log in next time without an email.
pickup_where_to: Where can you be picked up?
pickup_where_from: Where should you be dropped off?
public_drivers_one: one has room in their car
public_join_text: Tell us you’re coming, when and from where – and see who’s driving from your area.
map_hint_pickup: Tap the map to add a place.
map_hint_start: Tap the map to set the place.
map_nothing_there: No address found there – try a little next to it.
map_full: No more places possible – remove one first.
rides_contact_hint: Arrange where and when to meet directly:
details_notified: Everyone registered gets an e-mail with the new details.
profile_delete_events: You organize these events on your own – they will be deleted too:
profile_delete_events_hint: Should they go on? Invite someone to the team first (Settings › Team).

mail_changed_footer: The updated calendar entry is attached.

mail_cancelled_footer: You receive this message because you were registered.

mail_soon_still_seeking: {direction}: you’re still looking for a ride – have a look at the rides view.
mail_soon_footer: You get this reminder once before every event.
participants_add_hint: For people who don’t register themselves (e.g. by phone). They get an e-mail with a link to complete their details or to withdraw.
participants_add_error_unpublished: You can add people once the event is published.
participants_add_error_unverified: Please confirm your e-mail address first (see overview).
participants_add_error_invalid: Please enter a name and a valid e-mail address.
participants_add_error_rate: Very many people were added just now. Please try again later.
participants_done_added: {name} is registered and got an e-mail.

waitlist_you_are_waiting: You’re on the waiting list – place {position}.
waitlist_how: If a place becomes free, you move up automatically and get an e-mail. You’ll see the rides from then on.
mail_waitlist_intro: “{title}” is full right now – you’re on the waiting list, place {position}.

mail_waitlist_footer: You receive this message because you joined the list.

mail_promoted_hint: If it doesn’t suit you any more, please withdraw so the next person can move up.
participants_message_hint: Goes by e-mail to all {count} people registered. Replies go to the event’s contact address; you get a copy.
participants_message_waitlist: Also to the {count} on the waiting list
participants_message_error_invalid: Please enter a subject (up to 120 characters) and a message (up to 5000 characters).
participants_message_error_rate: 5 messages were already sent today. Tomorrow it works again.
mail_broadcast_footer: You receive this message because you are registered for “{title}”.
mail_broadcast_copy_text: Copy of your message to {count} people:

profile_email_change_sent: Check the inbox of {email} and click the link (valid for one hour).
profile_email_change_invalid: Please enter a valid new e-mail address.
email_change_confirm_text: Should {email} be your account’s e-mail address from now on?
email_change_done_text: Your account now uses {email}. Log in with this address from now on.
email_change_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one in your profile.
email_change_taken: There is already an account for this address by now – so everything stays as it was.

mail_email_change_intro: Hello! Confirm with the button that {email} should be the address of your toodle account from now on.
mail_email_change_validity: The link is valid for one hour and works only once.
mail_email_change_footer: Didn’t request this? Then just ignore this e-mail – nothing changes.

mail_email_changed_text: Hello! The e-mail address of your toodle account is now {email}. Wasn’t that you? Then please write to us at {contact}.
